wasmSmoothScroll

Smoothly scrolls a container (or the window) to a target element or numeric offset. Target resolution order: element (bounding rect relative to the container's scroll origin) → numeric scrollTo → {y}/{top} object → 0. Sub-SCROLL_MIN_DISTANCE moves early-out — an invisible scroll would still run a full RAF loop and promote the compositor layer for nothing. During the animation the scrolled root gets a GPU compositor promotion (will-change/transform) so the browser repaints a layer instead of relayouting, then releaseElementGPU restores it on the last frame. updateHistory rewrites #id via replaceState so it never pushes a history entry.

  • @param options Container/target/duration configuration.
